Haste

Eat. Log. Live.

A food journal that leaves room for real life. Start with a photo, a few words, or the details you already know.

Get the Android build ↓Free to try · Early access
ILLUSTRATIVE INTERFACE / 3D STUDY
01

Start with what you know

Use a photo, voice or text. Enter known nutrition manually when you have it.

02

Have the final say

Review portions and assumptions before saving. With AI connected, adjust and re-estimate.

03

See your days together

Browse daily logs, edit meals and repeat favourites. Food logs stay on your device.

YOURS TO TRY / ANDROID

Start with one meal.

Use the local explore flow to try manual food entry, then review and save a meal. Sign in for hosted food search and optional AI estimates.

AI estimates can be inaccurate and are subject to daily limits. Explore entries can be temporary, and local food logs do not automatically transfer to another phone.
